answers.rationale: I'm a pragmatic developer who values control and visibility. Inline diffs before accepting changes align perfectly with my workflow—I'd definitely use this feature because I can catch issues before they hit my codebase.

Checkpoint rollback is exactly what I need to feel confident delegating complex tasks to an agent. Knowing I can revert bad changes instantly removes my biggest hesitation about autonomous coding tools.

My main worry is that the agent might introduce subtle bugs or logic errors that pass a quick diff review but break functionality downstream. I need to trust the code quality, not just the visibility.
